prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas for the existing Momosup preschool woodland game. Reference image 1 is Momo, used ONLY for matching the fine warm watercolor/gouache painting style. Reference image 2 is ONLY a forest palette and texture reference. Do not include Momo or the landscape in this sheet.
Generate a square transparent RGBA image, ideally 2048 x 2048, with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of equal square cells, no visible grid. Each object must be isolated on genuine transparent background, centered inside its own cell, with at least 12% transparent padding on EVERY side. Objects must not touch or cross cell boundaries. Each object is one beautiful tactile hand-painted toy, strongly readable at 72px, warm upper-left light, soft modeled shading, fine paper/gouache brush texture, restrained sage green, honey oak, muted berry red, cream. Consistent three-quarter view. No faces, no eyes, no labels, no text, no UI badges, no cast drop shadows extending beyond object.
Strict row-major placement:
Row1 col1 a single ripe strawberry with green cap; col2 a single raspberry with green cap; col3 one round blueberry with a small leaf; col4 one oak acorn with textured brown cap.
Row2 col1 empty round woven wicker basket with handle and visible open mouth; col2 a lush rounded leafy bush with tiny pale flowers; col3 a small five-key wooden xylophone with muted rainbow keys and one mallet; col4 a round wooden shape-sorting board with ONE recessed star-shaped opening (no letters).
Row3 col1 wooden artist palette with four small colored paint daubs and a paintbrush; col2 warm golden sun with simple short soft rays (no face); col3 a small sage green woodland bus toy seen three-quarter side with wheels and windows; col4 a single peach-pink daisy with stem and two leaves.
Row4 col1 one fluffy cream-white cloud; col2 a single broad sage green leaf with visible veins pointing diagonally upward; col3 a small cozy hollow-tree stump cottage with moss roof and rounded glowing doorway; col4 a single horizontal thick wooden bridge plank with rounded ends, visible wood grain and two little wooden pegs.
The whole output is one practical atlas, no scene, no ornament between cells. Preserve actual alpha transparency. Use every cell exactly once.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE production character expression sprite atlas for the Momosup preschool game, with EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO rows on a transparent background. Target aspect ratio 2:1, ideally 2048x1024. Each of 8 cells must be an equal square, with 12% empty transparent margin on all sides. No grid lines, text, frames, shadows or backgrounds. Input image is the identity reference for Momo. Preserve that exact sage green little bird with creamy belly, two-leaf tuft, orange beak and feet, brown eyes, soft watercolor/gouache feather texture. Match proportions, height, head position, lighting and FOOT BASELINE exactly between cells so the poses can be swapped without jumping. Full body visible in each cell. Same frontal three-quarter view in ALL cells, feet touching the identical invisible baseline. Gentle, happy, never exaggerated.
Strict row-major frames:
0 top-left: relaxed idle, eyes open looking ahead, small closed beak, wings resting.
1 top-second: head tilted slightly toward viewer's LEFT, eyes looking left toward a nearby toy, closed beak, otherwise same body position.
2 top-third: head tilted slightly toward viewer's RIGHT, eyes looking right toward a nearby toy, closed beak, otherwise same body position.
3 top-fourth: eager to receive one berry, head looking slightly right, beak OPEN clearly (visible inner mouth), wings slightly lifted; no berry, no food in picture.
4 bottom-left: CHEW pose, beak closed, cheeks gently rounded/puffed, eyes softly happy, wings resting.
5 bottom-second: relaxed BLINK, both eyelids fully closed in gentle arcs, beak closed, same resting wings.
6 bottom-third: DELIGHTED after eating, eyes smiling in closed arcs, little open smiling beak, both wings slightly spread; grounded feet stay on identical baseline.
7 bottom-fourth: gentle HELLO, eyes open and viewer-left wing lifted in a small welcoming wave, other wing resting, little smile.
These are EIGHT images of the SAME character for animation, do not add props. Preserve actual alpha transparency between every feather and around every sprite. Consistent modest body mass, never a different bird.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE transparent production character sprite atlas. EXACTLY four columns by two rows, aspect 2:1, ideally2048x1024; eight equal square cells with 12% transparent padding, no grid or labels. Input1 is exact Duri identity, input2 exact Nuri identity. Fine watercolor/gouache matching original characters, warm light, sage/honey/cream palette, soft painted fur for bear, plush cloud texture for Nuri. Full bodies, same frontal three-quarter view, same character scale and invisible foot baseline within each row. No backgrounds, props, shadows, text or sparkle icons.
TOP row contains ONLY Duri, the small brown bear with round ears, cream muzzle/belly, brown eyes, rosy cheeks: col1 relaxed happy standing with paws resting; col2 curious attentive head tilt and slightly raised paw; col3 gently blinked eyes, same resting body; col4 happy greeting, smiling with one paw lifted to wave.
BOTTOM row contains ONLY Nuri, the creamy white cloud friend with original distinctive rounded cloud silhouette and curled forelock, tiny arms and feet, brown eyes and rosy cheeks: col1 relaxed open-eyed small smile; col2 curious head tilt with one small hand to cheek; col3 gently blinked eyes and soft closed smile; col4 delighted gentle smile, one arm lifted waving.
Keep anatomy and body position consistent; no bouncing or giant facial exaggeration. Strict single character per cell, exact four frames for each character. Actual RGBA transparency.
